summary.zh-Hans: 东京塔建于1958年，高333米。主展望台位于150米高处。
summary.en: Built in 1958, Tokyo Tower stands 333 meters tall, with its main observation deck at 150 meters.

summary.zh-Hans: 上野公园于1873年设立，是日本最早的一批公共公园之一。园内有多座博物馆和动物园。
summary.en: Established in 1873, Ueno Park was among Japan’s first public parks. Its grounds include several museums and a zoo.

summary.zh-Hans: 荞麦面在江户时代中期已是受欢迎的快餐，后来成为东京的地方美食之一。
summary.en: Soba was a popular quick meal by the middle of the Edo period and became a local specialty of Tokyo.

summary.zh-Hans: 文字烧将较稀的面粉糊与卷心菜等食材放在热铁板上烹制，是东京的地方美食之一。
summary.en: Monjayaki is a Tokyo specialty cooked on a hot griddle from a runny flour batter, cabbage and other ingredients.
